Alex (eng): Short Qs after the all-hands: 1) Are we tightening our mission wording to avoid being mistaken for a model provider? 2) Which competitor do we list first in one-pager? 3) Any changes to the roadmap priorities after the funding update?

Morgan (CEO): Yes, we'll sharpen the mission to focus on 'serving' (typo in slide), but core idea: predictable production inference across deployment modes. Competitors: list by buyer split  but put "LLM API vendors" first for PLG materials. Roadmap: minor reweighting  we accelerate private deployment work and dedicated scaling.

Sam (Head of Product): For messaging: use "Serve" as verb. "We help you serve models reliably". And add a brief line on observability and economics.

Ivy (VP Eng): From runtime: highlight that we handle production edge cases (KV cache correctness across rollouts, batching fairness). Those resonate with infra buyers.

Rafael (Strategy): Competitor note: avoid naming vendors in PLG collateral; in enterprise decks we can map competitors to buyer pain.

Leah (sales): Can we get a competitor matrix by EOD Monday? helps AEs.

reminder-bot: FYI: action item created -> /tasks/174000111 (Competitor matrix request).

Alex (eng): Thanks. Also small ask  can we include a canned response for "why not just run on cloud GPUs?"

Morgan (CEO): We'll craft a one-liner. Keep it focused: we own ops and optimizations, customers keep models.

Sam (Head of Product): Action: updating PLG copy and creating enterprise talking points.

Ivy (VP Eng): Action: doc runtime differentiators with 2-3 examples.

Leah (sales): Action: AEs will test messaging in customer calls this week.

Morgan (CEO): Thanks team. Post any further Qs here.
